    Berisp-like: a trophic model of contamination

    Example_Berisp_full.Rmd
    library(spacemodR)
library(rstan)
library(dplyr)
library(terra)

    Define a Spacemodel

    Habitat 

    ground_cd <- load_raster_extdata("ground_concentration_cd_compressed.tif")
names_hab = c("soil", "plant", "earthwom", "carabid", "mamHerb", "mamInsect")
list_habitat <- lapply(names_hab, function(i) ground_cd)
stack_habitat <- raster_stack(list_habitat, names_hab)

terra::plot(stack_habitat)

    Trophic web 

    trophic_df <- trophic() |>
  add_link("soil", "plant", 1) |>
  add_link("soil", "earthwom", 1) |>
  add_link("soil", "carabid", 1) |>
  # mamHerb
  add_link("soil", "mamHerb", 2/100) |>
  add_link("plant", "mamHerb", 90/100) |>
  add_link("earthwom", "mamHerb", 4/100) |>
  add_link("carabid", "mamHerb", 4/100) |>
  # mamInsect
  add_link("soil", "mamInsect", 2/100) |>
  add_link("earthwom", "mamInsect", 49/100) |>
  add_link("carabid", "mamInsect", 49/100)
    plot(trophic_df)

    Contaminantion by Cadmium

    Vegetation

    Earthworm

    For Cadmium, the equation is given by (Ma et al., 2004):

    logCearthworm=a+b×logCsoil+c×logOM+d×pH \log C_{earthworm} = a + b \times \log C_{soil} + c \times \log OM + d \times pH

    Carabid 

    inter_carab = -1
slope_carab = 0.6

    Transfer of food

    C=1b×food×Cfood×cupCout(1−exp−cout×a) C = \frac{1}{b} \times \frac{food \times C_{food} \times c_{up}}{C_{out}} \left( 1 - \exp^{- c_{out} \times a} \right) where:

    • bb: average individual biomass [g][g],
    • cupc_{up}: assimilation efficiency of food [n.d.][n.d.],
    • coutc_{out}: excretion rate of food, [day−1][day^{-1}]
    • aa: average age [day][day],
    • foodfood: amount of food ingested [g][g].
